title: China-Generated Clinical Data in FDA, EMA and NMPA Submissions
summary: How FDA and EMA assess clinical data generated mainly in China, and what NMPA expects from global programs in clinical trial applications.
body_markdown:
## China-generated clinical data in FDA, EMA and NMPA submissions: how regulators assess it, and what NMPA expects from global programs


### Key takeaways


- No FDA rule rejects clinical data because it comes from China. Under 21 CFR 312.120, FDA accepts a foreign non-IND study as support if it followed GCP (including IEC review and informed consent) and FDA can validate the data by inspection if needed. An NDA can rest solely on foreign data only if it also meets all three 21 CFR 314.106(b) conditions: applicability to the US population and US medical practice, investigators of recognized competence, and data that are valid without inspection or that FDA can validate[464](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-314.106)[202](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=202) .
- In practice, FDA has assessed single-country Chinese trials case by case, and applicability to US patients has been the deciding question. At ODAC, the sintilimab application (ORIENT-11, conducted only in China) drew a 14 to 1 vote that additional trials showing applicability to US patients should be required[548](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=548)[549](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=549) . By contrast, toripalimab and tislelizumab were assessed under a flexible, evidence-based approach[22](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=22)[133](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=133) .
- FDA's 2024 draft oncology MRCT guidance recommends that a single pivotal oncology MRCT span major geographic regions and not draw mainly from one country or region. It also asks for an adequately representative US subgroup[191](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=191)[77](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=77)[78](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=78) .
- EMA applies the same ICH E5 logic. Data from outside the EU/EEA must meet EU standards, and their applicability to the EEA population must be justified through intrinsic and extrinsic factors[163](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=163)[165](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=165) .
- NMPA's own framework goes the other way: it governs how overseas data are accepted in China (full, partial or non-acceptance, under the 2018 CDE guideline)[68](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=68)[69](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=69)[70](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=70)[71](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=71) . It also sets how Chinese patients must be represented in MRCTs (2015 MRCT guideline; 2026 benefit-risk guidance for global synchronous development)[378](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=378)[531](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=531)[533](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=533) . NMPA now offers a 30-working-day review pathway for qualifying innovative-drug clinical trials, including globally synchronized programs[472](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=472)[477](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=477) .


### The US legal framework for foreign clinical data


#### Non-IND foreign studies: 21 CFR 312.120


FDA will accept a well-designed, well-conducted foreign study that was not run under an IND, in support of either an IND or a marketing application, if two conditions are met[389](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[391](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) :


- The study followed GCP, including IEC approval before the study began and freely given informed consent[389](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[390](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) .
- FDA can validate the data through an on-site inspection if it considers one necessary[391](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) .


Separately, the sponsor must submit supporting information describing how it ensured GCP conformity. This covers investigator qualifications, a protocol and results summary, IEC details, how consent was obtained, subject incentives, sponsor monitoring, and investigator GCP training[393](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[394](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[397](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[399](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[400](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[401](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120)[402](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) .


A study that fails the two acceptance conditions will not be accepted as support. FDA will still examine its data[404](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) . Sponsors can ask for a waiver if they justify it, and FDA may grant one in the interest of public health[403](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-312.120) .


FDA's FAQ guidance on non-IND foreign studies asks sponsors to state whether each study used foreign-only or mixed domestic and foreign sites, and the IND status of each foreign site[206](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=206) . Multinational trials may combine US IND sites with foreign non-IND sites. Where data will be pooled, the protocols ordinarily should be very similar or identical, and FDA recommends discussing pooling plans with the review division[210](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=210) .


#### Foreign data as the sole basis for approval: 21 CFR 314.106


An NDA based only on foreign clinical data may be approved if the data meet US approval criteria and all three of the following hold[464](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-314.106) :


1. The data apply to the US population and US medical practice.
2. The studies were performed by clinical investigators of recognized competence.
3. The data can be considered valid without an FDA on-site inspection, or FDA can validate them by inspection or other appropriate means.


FDA applies this policy flexibly, depending on the nature of the drug and the data. The regulation encourages a presubmission meeting[464](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-314.106)[465](https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/section-314.106) .


#### Verifiability and records access


FDA's inspection guidance says its international inspections generally focus on studies that supply data critical to approval, including foreign non-IND sites[222](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=222) . For non-US, non-IND studies, inspections help FDA judge whether the study complies with 312.120[223](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=223) . FDA's EHR guidance warns that if records are unavailable, FDA may be unable to accept non-IND foreign data. Where foreign law bars disclosure, a sponsor may seek a waiver, but FDA and the sponsor must agree on another way to validate the data[225](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=225) . This matters for China-based programs that are subject to data-export controls (see the HGR section below).


### How FDA has applied these principles to China-generated data


#### Sintilimab (ORIENT-11): the reference case for single-country data


FDA's ODAC briefing concluded that ORIENT-11 and its results did not meet the criteria for accepting foreign data under 21 CFR 312.120 and 314.106, even though the trial met its primary PFS endpoint[269](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=269)[270](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=270) . The review issues were:


- **Not an MRCT.** Because the trial ran only in China, regional consistency of the treatment effect could not be assessed. FDA cited ICH E17 and said it preferred an MRCT[271](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=271) .
- **Population differences.** Patients were younger, more often male, less often current or former smokers, and entirely Asian, unlike the US NSCLC population. FDA also pointed to differences in concomitant and herbal medications and in regional medical practice[272](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=272)[273](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=273) .
- **Comparator not US standard of care.** The control arm was placebo plus pemetrexed and platinum, not a regimen containing an immune checkpoint inhibitor[274](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=274)[275](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=275) . FDA also noted that the trial was powered for PFS while existing first-line immunotherapies had shown an overall survival benefit. It recommended a head-to-head MRCT against an approved checkpoint inhibitor[276](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=276) .
- **Trial conduct and verification.** Inspecting a few sites could not establish data quality across all sites, and the investigators had limited prior MRCT experience[277](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=277) . Patients were not reconsented after pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy was approved in China[278](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=278) . The applicant also had not consulted FDA on design, endpoint or control-arm selection[279](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=279) .


ODAC voted on whether additional trials demonstrating applicability to US patients and US medical care should be required before a final decision. The result was 14 Yes, 1 No, 0 abstentions[548](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=548)[549](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=549) . FDA stated the governing principle as applicability to the US population and practice, not a ban on single-country data[550](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=550)[551](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=551) .


#### Toripalimab (JUPITER-02): flexibility where epidemiology and comparator support it


FDA reviewers accepted Asia-only data for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC) under 314.106(b), applied flexibly[22](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=22)[23](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=23)[24](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=24) . The factors that supported flexibility were:


- **Epidemiology.** More than 75% of global NPC cases occur in South and East Asia, versus 1.6% in Northern America[26](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=26) .
- **Unmet need.** No FDA-approved immunotherapy for NPC existed at the time of review[25](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=25) .
- **Comparator.** The cisplatin plus gemcitabine control was the US standard first-line treatment[25](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=25) .


Reviewers were explicit about the limits. All patients were Asian, the populations did not reflect US racial and ethnic diversity, and keratinizing histology was underrepresented[27](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=27)[28](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=28) . Race- and region-based subgroup analyses were not possible[29](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=29)[31](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=31) . FDA conducted clinical site inspections to validate the data[28](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=28) . The applicant committed to collecting more data in a population more representative of US patients[28](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=28) .


#### Tislelizumab: subgroup consistency and supporting evidence


For RATIONALE-302 in ESCC, only 21% of patients were enrolled outside Asia. Reviewers nonetheless agreed that the results applied to the US population. Their reasons were exploratory subgroup consistency, SEER data showing no outcome differences by race or ethnicity, epidemiology, mechanism of action, class safety, and clinical pharmacology[133](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=133) . For RATIONALE-306, where China accounted for 57% of enrollment and the US for less than 1%, FDA selected high-enrolling Chinese sites for inspection. It found the data from both inspected sites acceptable[134](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=134)[135](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=135) .


#### Penpulimab: an interim CRL calling for a US-representative MRCT


The January 19, 2024 CRL to Akeso for penpulimab-kcqx in NPC found that the existing study did not provide a meaningful advantage over available therapy[280](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=280)[288](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=288) . As the path forward, FDA asked for a multiregional randomized trial with PFS and OS endpoints. It said the trial "should enroll an adequate representation of U.S. patients" whose demographics reflect the more ethnically diverse NPC population[289](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=289) . The CRL does not itself describe the earlier data as China-only. FDA later approved penpulimab-kcqx on April 23, 2025 for recurrent or metastatic non-keratinizing NPC, first-line with cisplatin or carboplatin and gemcitabine, and as a single agent for metastatic non-keratinizing NPC with disease progression on or after platinum-based chemotherapy and at least one other prior line of therapy.


### FDA's forward-looking policy on multiregional programs


- **Oncology MRCT draft guidance (September 2024).** FDA's paramount consideration is whether results apply to the intended US population and US oncology care[76](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=76) . Sponsors should enroll enough US participants for a robust US assessment[78](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=78) . For cancers common in the US, FDA recommends equal allocation across selected major regions, including North America[77](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=77) . A single pivotal MRCT should span major geographic regions and not draw mainly from one country or region[191](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=191) . Heavy enrollment in one foreign region may be acceptable if other pivotal trials enroll a US-representative population, and FDA recommends discussing this early[218](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=218)[84](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=84) .
- **Diversity Action Plans draft guidance (June 2024).** For multinational studies, enrollment goals should cover the whole study, and site selection should account for the US intended-use population[80](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=80) .
- **Postmarketing draft guidance (August 2023).** Applications that enroll mainly outside the US should include supporting data and a rationale. FDA may request or require additional studies in US-relevant subpopulations[106](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=106) .
- **Device submissions.** GCP compliance does not replace the need to show applicability to the US population and medical practice[204](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=204) . PMA filing review checks for a justification of US applicability when the primary study uses foreign data[109](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=109) .


### The shared foundation: ICH E5 and E17


ICH E5 separates two questions[437](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=437) :


1. Does the data package meet the new region's regulatory standards?
2. Can the results be extrapolated to the new region's population?


Foreign data can give full or partial support, and repeating the whole program is not required[438](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=438) . Ethnic insensitivity alone does not cure an unacceptable endpoint or control[439](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=439) . Ethnic factors include intrinsic ones (such as genetic polymorphism and body size) and extrinsic ones (such as medical practice and trial conduct)[440](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=440)[441](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=441) . Bridging studies range from none, to PD-endpoint studies, to controlled clinical trials, depending on ethnic sensitivity and how similar medical practice is[446](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=446)[447](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=447)[448](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=448) .


ICH E17 defines consistency of treatment effect as the absence of clinically relevant regional differences[452](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=452) . It calls for regional sample allocation that supports consistency assessment and avoids domination by a single region[456](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=456) . It allows prespecified pooled regions or subpopulations when they are scientifically justified[458](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=458)[461](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=461) .


### EMA


EMA applies E5 directly. Data from outside the EU/EEA must meet EU standards for the nature and quality of evidence, wherever they were generated, and must comply with GCP[163](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=163)[164](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=164) . The 2012 reflection paper asks applicants to justify applicability to the EEA population through intrinsic and extrinsic differences[165](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=165) . EMA's extrapolation paper names medical practice, disease definition and study population as key factors. It notes that global development does not automatically justify an unrestricted EU indication[167](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=167) . One example: extrapolation from a Chinese pivotal insulin trial was questioned because patients had lower BMI and fewer complications. This was a specific applicability finding, not a general rejection of Chinese data[169](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=169) . EMA recommends EU scientific advice before trials outside the EU begin[176](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=176) .


### What NMPA/CDE expects


#### Accepting overseas data in Chinese applications


CDE's *Technical Guidelines for Accepting Overseas Clinical Trial Data of Drugs* (11 July 2018) applies to overseas data submitted for drug registration in China[52](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=52)[60](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=60) . Its core requirements are:


- **Data integrity.** Data must be authentic, complete, accurate and traceable, and generated under ICH GCP[61](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=61) .
- **Complete submission.** All overseas clinical data must be submitted. Selective submission is prohibited[62](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=62) .
- **Ethnic sensitivity analysis.** This should cover region and race, and assess whether the Chinese subgroup is consistent with the overall population, following ICH E5[64](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=64)[65](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=65)[66](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=66)[67](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=67) .


The guideline sets three outcomes:


Outcome Conditions and consequence


Full acceptance Compliant, reliable data that adequately support the indication, with no ethnic sensitivity affecting efficacy or safety[69](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=69)


Partial acceptance Ethnic factors create substantial uncertainty. The sponsor communicates with CDE and runs targeted trials in China[70](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=70)


Non-acceptance Major data-quality problems. A systematic Chinese development program is required[71](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=71)


Data that fall under partial acceptance may receive conditional acceptance for critical illnesses, rare diseases and pediatric uses that lack effective treatment, with more data collected after marketing[72](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=72) . For drugs marketed abroad but not yet in China, CDE's October 2020 requirements call for bridging trials when ethnic-sensitivity data are missing or ethnic sensitivity is present. These include PK/PD, efficacy and safety studies and, where needed, dose exploration[74](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=74) . Exemption from domestic trials "may be considered" for drugs with no ethnic sensitivity. It is not automatic[75](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=75) .


#### Chinese participation in MRCTs


CDE's *Guidelines for International Multicenter Drug Clinical Trials (Trial)* (30 January 2015) sets these expectations:


- Sponsors must define China's position in the global development plan in advance[382](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=382) .
- Chinese enrollment must be enough to support conclusions on safety and efficacy in Chinese patients and should reflect Chinese clinical practice[378](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=378) .
- Regional allocation must be scientifically justified. No fixed percentage is set[379](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=379) .
- Consistency methods must be prespecified[380](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=380) .
- Reports should compare Asian with non-Asian results, and Chinese results with those of other countries[381](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=381) .


The 2026 *Guidelines for Benefit-Risk Assessment Based on Multi-Regional Clinical Trial Data in the Global Synchronous Development of New Drugs (Trial)* (24 February 2026) builds on this:


- **Early Chinese data.** Sponsors are encouraged to start early trials in China as soon as possible. They should assess differences in exposure, metabolic-enzyme polymorphisms and PD response[526](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=526)[527](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=527) . East Asian data can help but are not automatically interchangeable with Chinese data[528](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=528) . The December 2024 draft said more directly that Chinese PK and dose-exposure-response information should ideally be obtained before a site joins a confirmatory MRCT[385](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=385) .
- **Consistency assessment.** Consistency means no clinically relevant regional difference, assessed with prespecified methods and a structured framework for investigating inconsistency[531](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=531) .
- **Use of global results.** Global conclusions are the primary basis for the regional benefit-risk assessment, supported by inter-regional comparisons[533](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=533) .
- **Unexplained inconsistency.** The sponsor should examine whether chance explains the difference, reach consensus with the review authority, and assess benefit-risk on the totality of evidence[540](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=540) .


#### Clinical trial application procedure


- **Review clocks.** China operates a 60-working-day implied-licensing system for clinical trials[494](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=494)[354](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=354) . Under NMPA Announcement No. 86 of 2025 (published 12 September 2025, effective on publication), a 30-working-day pathway covers qualifying Category 1 innovative drugs[466](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=466)[472](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=472)[474](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=474)[482](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=482) . Eligible programs include Phase I and II trials of globally synchronized products, and Phase III MRCTs led or co-led by Chinese principal investigators[477](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=477) .
- **30-day pathway conditions.** Applicants must run ethics review in parallel with the lead site and commit to starting the trial within 12 weeks of approval[478](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=478) . Applications must be marked "30-day pathway"[479](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=479) . If complex issues arise, CDE can extend the review to the standard 60 working days, with notice given within 20 working days[479](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=479) .
- **Protocol completeness.** CDE's protocol review specification (October 2022 draft) expects a complete overall clinical development plan and full protocols. A protocol framework alone is not enough for approval[356](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=356)[357](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=357) .
- **Drugs urgently needed in China.** NMPA Announcement No. 3 of 2026 covers overseas-marketed drugs with urgent clinical need. It encourages synchronous development, allows communication with CDE on using domestic and foreign data, and provides a clinical trial decision within 30 days of acceptance where a trial is required[562](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=562)[563](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=563)[564](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=564) .


#### Human genetic resources (HGR)


An international collaborative trial aimed at Chinese marketing authorization may use filing instead of approval if it does not export HGR materials. Sample processing must stay within the clinical institutions or with domestic entities designated in the protocol[40](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=40)[41](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=41) . The Chinese and foreign parties apply jointly[45](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=45) . For multicenter trials, the sponsor or lead institution files once for the whole study[46](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=46) . The trial may begin only after a filing number is issued[47](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=47) . Exploratory research within such a trial needs an international research cooperation licence[43](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=43) . Sponsors relying on Chinese sites for US or EU submissions should plan these constraints alongside FDA's records-access expectations[225](https://rhizomeai.com/articles/china-generated-clinical-data-in-fda-ema-and-nmpa?showSourceNumber=225) .
